intended_application: Developer assistance with low-risk unit tests and documentation, subject to human review
business_need: Reduce documentation and test-writing backlog without degrading code quality
users_stakeholders: Developers, engineering leads, security, QA, product customers
capabilities_constraints: Existing CI and code review; small platform team; no internal tool-evaluation baseline yet; repository confidentiality rules
risk_consequence_context: Moderate: generated code can create defects or expose source, but changes can be reviewed and reverted
management_question: When and how should the engineering team assess a limited, reversible coding-assistant pilot?
additional_context: Illustrative case only. Reference the same 2025 Stack Overflow and DORA survey observations in all three tests; internal baseline and peer deployment prevalence are unknown.
